bio.text: Herron Keyon Gaston, a Democrat, was elected in November 2022 to represent Connecticut's 23rd Senate District, covering parts of Bridgeport and Stratford.
He is Senior Pastor of Summerfield United Methodist Church in Bridgeport and Vice President and Chief of Staff at the University of Bridgeport.
He was previously Assistant Chief Administrative Officer for the City of Bridgeport and served as a Gubernatorial Fellow in the Florida Governor's Office.
He grew up in Florida and attended Florida A&M University, where he earned a B.A. in political science.
